reply_text:
Pree, the ticket is #8841. I replied in a thread under your message in #central-random.

Where it comes from: yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27) Tobias said in #central-random that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. He didn't name the account. He was answering Hollis's question about "Tobias's dealer account," and I'm treating that as Marrow Fieldworks.

Two things to know:
- In my reply I said the January handoff digest shows Marrow Fieldworks moving to Tobias. That goes further than the digest does. It says the account changed hands on Jan 5 and calls it your dealer account before then, but it doesn't say who took it over. I worked that out from Hollis's wording.
- I can't see any ticket files, so I couldn't check #8841's current status. Tobias is the one to ask before the call.

In the reply I also warned you not to mix it up with #88412 (the old Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket) or #4409/#4412 (older Marrow Fieldworks tickets at the Salina North yard).
